Agents can take dozens of small steps before they answer. Showing every one buries the answer, and hiding them makes the agent feel like a black box. Tool Calls gives each step one quiet line that reads like a sentence, such as “Read components/search.tsx” or “Searched for useResults, 3 results”.

Every AI SDK tool state has its own look and wording, including approvals. Approving offers Allow, Deny, Always allow and “Tell it what to do instead”, which sends your words back as the reason, with ⌘↵ and ⌘⌫ from the keyboard. getToolPartStatus maps tool parts for you, and ready-made views cover search results, file lists, multiple-choice questions and raw JSON.
